source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of photodegradable plastics (PDF 155-156).

blocks.text: Kuch functional groups dhoop se ultraviolet roshni ki shakal mein tawanai jazb kar sakte hain. Aise groups wale polymers roshni se toot sakte hain aur photodegradable kehlate hain. Zanjeeron mein carbonyl groups (C=O) wale kuch polymers is liye banaye gaye hain ke yeh UV zyada jazb karte hain. Jazb shuda UV roshni zanjeeron ke andar bonds aur zanjeeron ke darmiyan quwwaton ko kamzor karti hai, jis se polymer zyada biodegradable hota aur mahol mein kam zehreele compounds mein jaldi toot'ta hai.

Lekin photodegradable plastics lambe arse use nahi ho sakte, aur in ki recycling mo'assar nahi. Saath hi zyada tar plastic landfills mein dabaya jata hai, jahan photodegradation ke liye roshni nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: Photodegradable plastics ka aik faida aur aik kami batayein.
blocks.explanation: Faida: in ke C=O groups UV jazb karte hain, is liye yeh mahol mein jaldi toot'te hain. Kami: landfill mein roshni nahi (ya: in ki karamad umar kam aur recycling mushkil).

items: Photodegradable: C=O groups UV jazb kar ke polymer kamzor karte.
Hudood: kam umar, kamzor recycling, landfills mein roshni nahi.
